subject: Retention exception request: proposed concession + SLA add-on for ACME
content:
Message 1
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Need approval: retention concession proposal for ACME (upcoming renewal)

Rishi / Laura —

Quick context: ACME's annual contract is coming up for renewal (term ends 2026-04-30). They informed us last week they're evaluating alternatives due to unit-cost pressures and a sudden headcount pullback. Jordan from ACME flagged price and SLA as the main levers.

What I'm proposing to save the account (details attached):
- One-time customer credit: $40,000 applied at renewal
- One-time 10% invoice-level concession for the first 3 months post-renewal (to ease immediate cost hit)
- Add SLA: 99.9% monthly uptime commitment with a 10% service credit for any monthly outage > 60 minutes
- Reset contract term to 12 months (start date 2026-05-01)

Rationale: ACME is strategic (multi-product adoption roadmap) and likely to expand in H2 if we keep them. Margin impact is material but recoverable via committed usage targets and a short term reset. Attach: ACME_Current_Contract_v3.pdf, Concession_P&L_impact.xlsx, Proposed_Redline_ACME.docx

Ask: Rishi — can you sign off on exec-level exception for the above concessions? If approved, I'll send the revised redline to contracts and Jordan this week and prepare a DocuSign.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

---

Message 2
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Need approval: retention concession proposal for ACME (upcoming renewal)

Thanks for the summary, Marissa. A few quick requests before I can approve: please send
- a short one-pager on commercial rationale (win-back probability, expansion motion, churn risk)
- clear margin impact numbers (ARR / MRR delta, expected payback period)
- legal redline callouts for the SLA language (Dylan)

Laura — any preliminary finance concerns if we do a $40k credit plus a 10% short-term concession? If we can compress to a smaller credit + term extension, that's probably preferable.

I want us to be decisive but not set a precedent that we'll give outsized credits for price pushes. If ACME signs a 12-month commit with usage floors, I am more inclined to approve.

Rishi
VP, Sales Operations
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

---

Message 3
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Need approval: retention concession proposal for ACME (upcoming renewal)

Attached the one-pager and updated P&L sheet per Rishi's ask. Highlights:
- ACME current ARR: $960k
- Proposed concession impact: ~$52k first-year revenue reduction (includes the $40k credit + 3 months of 10% concession)
- Expected payback: 8-10 months if they resume projected usage from Q3 onboarding of additional teams
- Sales confidence: 70% (they're close on product fit; primary barrier is budget timing)

Jordan — can you confirm the customer's willingness to sign a 12-month term with a minimum usage target (we proposed 60% of prior year spend in Q1-Q2)? If not, we may need a slightly larger upfront concession.

Attachments: Concession_P&L_impact.xlsx, ACME_Retention_OnePager.pdf, Proposed_Redline_ACME.docx

Marissa

---

Message 4
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Need approval: retention concession proposal for ACME (upcoming renewal)

Appreciate the detail, team. Quick finance read:
- $40k one-time credit + 10% discount for 3 months gives a ~5.4% first-year revenue reduction on this account which is significant but manageable given ACME's strategic potential.
- Prefer term extension + smaller credit to preserve pricing integrity. Counter proposal for approval: $25k one-time credit + 10% discount for 1 month (or 3% blended first-year impact) + reset to 12-month term with clear usage-floor clause and quarterly review.

If Sales is confident we can enforce usage floors (reporting + clawback language), I can support up to $30k credit. Anything above needs CFO sign-off. Also need Legal to vet SLA add-on language — any open indemnity or penalty language should be limited.

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachments: Finance_Impact_Summary.xlsx

---

Message 5
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>, Helen Park <helen.park@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Approval: ACME concession package (exec sign-off)

After reviewing the trade-offs and Finance's guidance, I approve the following as an exception to our standard renewal terms for ACME:
- One-time credit: $30,000 (applied at renewal)
- 10% invoice concession for the first billing cycle post-renewal (one month only)
- Contract term reset to 12 months (2026-05-01 to 2027-04-30) with a usage-floor clause: customer agrees to at least 60% of prior year spend; failure to meet floor triggers a prorated clawback over the next invoice
- SLA commitment: 99.9% monthly uptime with service credit capped at 10% of monthly invoice per incident and overall cap of $75k annually

Marissa — proceed to send the redline to ACME and prepare DocuSign. Finance will prepare the accounting treatment; Legal (Dylan) to finalize SLA language and confirm no open indemnities. Jordan / Helen — thank you for working with us; Marissa will share the updated contract by EOD tomorrow.

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Sales Operations
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: Proposed_Redline_ACME.docx
DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/abc123
